en: Dhammānulomapaccanīya (3), Dukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (2) 14.16. The Pair on the Taints and Things Subject to Taints (Āsavasāsavaduka)
Dependent on a state that is both an *āsava* and associated with *āsavas*, there arises a state that is neither an *āsava* nor associated with *āsavas*, by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
Dependent on a state that is both an *āsava* and associated with *āsavas*, there arises a state that is neither an *āsava* nor not an *āsava*, by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is both an *āsava* and associated with *āsavas*, there arises a state that is neither an *āsava* nor associated with *āsavas*... [and] neither an *āsava* nor not an *āsava*.
Conditioned by states that are both with-taints and not-taints, as well as neither-taints nor taints, states that are neither-taints nor taints arise by way of root-condition.
Conditioned by a state that is with-taints and not a taint, states that are neither-taints nor taints arise by way of root-condition … three [combinations].

Conditioned by states that are both taints and with-taints, and also states that are with-taints and not taints, states that are neither-taints nor with-taints arise by way of root-condition … three [combinations]. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, nine; ... pe ... in the case of the result condition, one; ... pe ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition, nine. (In all cases, nine.)
